title.en: Reading: Our minorities in the world

intro.en: A reading passage about Muslims who live as minorities in non-Muslim lands and the problems they face: worship, family matters, education and social life.
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matn un Musalmanon ke baare mein jo ghair-Muslim mulkon mein aqliyyat ban kar rehte hain aur unke masail: ibadat, ghar ke masail, taleem aur muashrati zindagi.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ قِرائِيٌّ عَنِ المُسْلِمينَ الَّذينَ يَعيشونَ أَقَلِّيّاتٍ في بِلادٍ غَيْرِ إِسْلامِيَّة، وَعَنِ المَشاكِلِ الَّتي تُواجِهُهُمْ في العِبادَةِ وَالأُسْرَةِ وَالتَّعْليمِ وَالحَياةِ الاجْتِماعِيَّة.

dialogue.ar: كانَ المُسْلِمونَ قَديماً يَغْتَرِبونَ عَنْ أَوْطانِهِمْ لِأَسْبابٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ، مِنْها طَلَبُ العِلْمِ وَالرِّزْقِ وَالدَّعْوَةُ إِلى الإِسْلامِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna l-muslimūna qadīman yaghtaribūna ʿan awṭānihim liʾasbābin mukhtalifa minhā ṭalabu l-ʿilmi war-rizqi wad-daʿwatu ilā l-ʾislām
dialogue.en: In the past, Muslims used to leave their homelands for various reasons, among them seeking knowledge and livelihood and calling to Islam.
dialogue.ur: Pehle zamane mein Musalman mukhtalif wajuhat se apne watan chhor kar pardes jaate the, jaise ilm aur rozi ki talash aur Islam ki dawat.

dialogue.ar: وَاسْتَقَرَّ بَعْضُهُمْ في بِلادٍ غَيْرِ إِسْلامِيَّةٍ، فَصاروا أَقَلِّيّاتٍ بَيْنَ سُكّانِها.
dialogue.tr: wastaqarra baʿḍuhum fī bilādin ghayri islāmiyya fa-ṣārwā aqalliyyātin bayna sukkānihā
dialogue.en: Some of them settled in non-Muslim lands and became minorities among their inhabitants.
dialogue.ur: Kuch unmein se ghair-Islami mulkon mein basay gaye aur wahan ke baashindon ke darmiyan aqliyyat ban gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَأَوَّلُ ما يَحْتاجونَ إِلَيْهِ مَسْجِدٌ يَجْتَمِعونَ فيهِ لِلصَّلاةِ، وَقَدْ لا يَجِدونَهُ قَريباً مِنْ بُيوتِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: wa-ʾawwalu mā yaḥtājūna ilayhi masjidun yajtamiʿūna fīhi liṣ-ṣalā wa-qad lā yajidūnahu qarīban min buywtihim
dialogue.en: The first thing they need is a mosque to gather in for prayer, and they may not find one near their homes.
dialogue.ur: Sab se pehle unhein ek masjid ki zaroorat hoti hai jahan woh namaz ke liye jama hon, aur kabhi woh apne gharon ke qareeb nahi milti.

dialogue.ar: وَيَحْتاجونَ كَذَلِكَ إِلى مَنْ يُعَلِّمُهُمْ أُمورَ دينِهِمْ وَيُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَتِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: wa-yaḥtājūna kadhalika ilā man yuʿallimuhum umūra dīnihim wa-yujību ʿan asʾilatihim
dialogue.en: They also need someone to teach them the matters of their religion and answer their questions.
dialogue.ur: Unhein aise shakhs ki bhi zaroorat hoti hai jo unhein deen ki baatein sikhaye aur unke sawalon ke jawab de.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ يَصْعُبُ عَلى المُسْلِمِ في عَمَلِهِ أَنْ يَجِدَ وَقْتاً لِلصَّلاةِ أَوْ مَكاناً هادِئاً لَها.
dialogue.tr: wa-qad yaṣʿubu ʿalā l-muslimi fī ʿamalihi an yajida wa-qtan liṣ-ṣalāti aw makānan hādiʾan lahā
dialogue.en: It may be hard for a Muslim at work to find time for prayer or a quiet place for it.
dialogue.ur: Kaam ki jagah par Musalman ke liye namaz ka waqt ya uske liye pur-sukoon jagah milna mushkil ho sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَظْهَرُ لَدَيْهِمْ مَسائِلُ تَخُصُّ الزَّواجَ وَالطَّلاقَ وَالميراثَ، لِأَنَّ قَوانينَ تِلْكَ البِلادِ تَخْتَلِفُ عَمّا يَعْرِفونَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-taẓharu ladayhim masāʾilu takhuṣṣu z-zawāja waṭ-ṭalāqa wal-mīrāth liʾanna qawānīna tilka l-bilādi takhtalifu ʿammā yaʿrifūnah
dialogue.en: Questions arise for them about marriage, divorce and inheritance, because the laws of those countries differ from what they know.
dialogue.ur: Unke saamne shaadi, talaq aur wirasat ke masail aate hain, kyunke un mulkon ke qawaneen us se mukhtalif hote hain jo woh jaante hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَحْرِصُ الآباءُ عَلى تَعْليمِ أَبْنائِهِمْ دينَهُمْ وَلُغَتَهُمْ، لَكِنَّ الوَقْتَ وَالإِمْكاناتِ قَليلَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: wa-yaḥriṣu l-ʾābāʾu ʿalā taʿlīmi abnāʾihim dīnahum wa-lughatahum lakinna l-waqta wal-ʾimkānāti qalīla
dialogue.en: Fathers are keen to teach their children their religion and language, but time and resources are limited.
dialogue.ur: Walid apne bachon ko deen aur zubaan sikhane ka shauq rakhte hain, lekin waqt aur wasail kam hote hain.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ تَجِدُ الفَتاةُ المُسْلِمَةُ صُعوبَةً في المَدْرَسَةِ أَوِ العَمَلِ بِسَبَبِ حِجابِها، لِأَنَّ بَعْضَ النّاسِ لا يَفْهَمونَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-qad tajidu l-fatātu l-muslimatu ṣuʿūbatan fī l-madrasati awi l-ʿamali bisababi ḥijābihā liʾanna baʿḍa n-nāsi lā yafhamūnah
dialogue.en: A Muslim girl may face difficulty at school or work because of her hijab, because some people do not understand it.
dialogue.ur: Musalman ladki ko school ya kaam mein apne hijab ki wajah se mushkil pesh aa sakti hai, kyunke kuch log use samajhte nahi.

dialogue.ar: وَيَجِدُ بَعْضُهُمْ صُعوبَةً في دَفْنِ مَوْتاهُمْ في مَقابِرَ تُناسِبُ دينَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: wa-yajidu baʿḍuhum ṣuʿūbatan fī dafni mawtāhum fī maqābira tunāsibu dīnahum
dialogue.en: Some of them find it hard to bury their dead in cemeteries that suit their religion.
dialogue.ur: Kuch ko apne marne walon ko aise qabristan mein dafn karna mushkil lagta hai jo unke deen ke mutabiq ho.

dialogue.ar: وَمَعَ هَذِهِ المُشْكِلاتِ يَتَعاوَنُ المُسْلِمونَ هُناكَ عَلى بِناءِ المَساجِدِ وَالمَدارِسِ لِيَحْفَظوا هُوِيَّتَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: wa-maʿa hadhihi l-mushkilāti yataʿāwanu l-muslimūna hunāka ʿalā bināʾi l-masājidi wal-madārisi liyaḥfaẓwā huwiyyatahum
dialogue.en: Despite these problems, the Muslims there cooperate in building mosques and schools so as to preserve their identity.
dialogue.ur: In mushkilat ke bawajood wahan ke Musalman masjidein aur madrase banane mein ek doosre ka saath dete hain taake apni pehchan mehfooz rakhen.

vocab.en: to live abroad, leave one's homeland

q.en: Why did many Muslims leave their countries in the past?
q.ur: Pehle bohat se Musalman apne mulk kyun chhor kar gaye?
q.ar: لِماذا غادَرَ كَثيرٌ مِنَ المُسْلِمينَ بِلادَهُمْ قَديماً؟

options: To seek knowledge, a livelihood or spread Islam

options_ar: جَماعاتٌ قَليلَةُ العَدَدِ بِالنِّسْبَةِ إِلى غَيْرِها

q.en: Which is a problem Muslims face in non-Muslim lands (from the text)?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq ghair-Muslim mulkon mein ek masla kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ هَذِهِ مُشْكِلَةٌ تُواجِهُ المُسْلِمينَ في بِلادٍ غَيْرِ إِسْلامِيَّةٍ حَسَبَ النَّصّ؟

options_ar: وُجودُ مَساجِدَ كَثيرَةٍ في كُلِّ مَكان
عَقْدٌ يَجْمَعُ رَجُلاً وَامْرَأَةً لِتَكْوينِ أُسْرَة

intro.en: Check your understanding of the passage: mark each sentence true or false, then learn useful words about minorities, family and education.
intro.ur: Matn ki samajh jaanchein: har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat batayein, phir aqliyyat, khandan aur taleem ke mutaalliq alfaz seekhein.
intro.ar: اخْتَبِرْ فَهْمَكَ لِلنَّصّ: حَدِّدْ كُلَّ جُمْلَةٍ صَحيحَةً أَوْ خاطِئَة، ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمْ كَلِماتٍ مُفيدَةً عَنِ الأَقَلِّيّاتِ وَالأُسْرَةِ وَالتَّعْليم.

dialogue.ar: طَلَبُ العِلْمِ كانَ مِنْ أَسْبابِ اغْتِرابِ المُسْلِمينَ قَديماً.
dialogue.tr: ṭalabu l-ʿilmi kāna min asbābi ghtirābi l-muslimīna qadīmā
dialogue.en: Seeking knowledge was one of the reasons Muslims lived abroad in the past.
dialogue.ur: Ilm ki talash purane zamane mein Musalmanon ke pardes jaane ki wajuhat mein se thi.

dialogue.ar: تَعيشُ الأَقَلِّيّاتُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ في بِلادٍ أَكْثَرُ سُكّانِها غَيْرُ مُسْلِمينَ.
dialogue.tr: taʿīshu l-ʾaqalliyyātu l-ʾislāmiyyatu fī bilādin aktharu sukkānihā ghayru muslimīn
dialogue.en: Muslim minorities live in countries where most of the inhabitants are not Muslims.
dialogue.ur: Musalman aqliyyatein aise mulkon mein rehti hain jin ke zyadatar baashinde Musalman nahi hote.

dialogue.ar: يَحْتاجُ المُسْلِمونَ في الغُرْبَةِ إِلى مَسْجِدٍ وَمَدْرَسَةٍ لِأَبْنائِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: yaḥtāju l-muslimūna fī l-ghurbati ilā masjidin wa-madrasatin liʾabnāʾihim
dialogue.en: Muslims abroad need a mosque and a school for their children.
dialogue.ur: Pardes mein Musalmanon ko apne bachon ke liye masjid aur madrase ki zaroorat hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: المَحْكَمَةُ مَكانٌ يُصَلّي فيهِ المُسْلِمونَ. صَحِّحِ الخَطَأَ.
dialogue.tr: al-maḥkamatu makānun yuṣallī fīhi l-muslimūn ṣaḥḥiḥi l-khaṭaʾ
dialogue.en: The court is a place where Muslims pray. Correct the mistake.
dialogue.ur: Adalat woh jagah hai jahan Musalman namaz parhte hain. Ghalti durust karein.

q.en: «تَعيشُ الأَقَلِّيّاتُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ في بِلادٍ أَكْثَرُ سُكّانِها غَيْرُ مُسْلِمينَ» is:
q.ur: «تَعيشُ الأَقَلِّيّاتُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ في بِلادٍ أَكْثَرُ سُكّانِها غَيْرُ مُسْلِمينَ» yeh jumla hai:
q.ar: الجُمْلَةُ «تَعيشُ الأَقَلِّيّاتُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ في بِلادٍ أَكْثَرُ سُكّانِها غَيْرُ مُسْلِمينَ» هِيَ:

options: False, they live only in Muslim lands
options_ar: خاطِئَة، فَهُمْ يَعيشونَ في بِلادٍ إِسْلامِيَّةٍ فَقَط

intro.en: A conditional sentence has a tool (أَداة), a condition verb (فِعْلُ الشَّرْطِ) and a result (جَوابُ الشَّرْطِ). These tools make both verbs jussive (majzūm). Example: إِنْ تَتَّقوا اللهَ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ فُرْقاناً – If you fear Allah, He will give you a criterion.
intro.ur: Shart ke jumle mein teen cheezein hoti hain: adaat, fi'l-ush-shart aur jawab-ush-shart. Yeh adawat dono fi'l ko majzoom kar deti hain. Misal: إِنْ تَتَّقوا اللهَ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ فُرْقاناً – Agar tum Allah se daro to woh tumhein furqan (farq karne ki salahiyat) dega.
intro.ar: الجُمْلَةُ الشَّرْطِيَّةُ لَها أَداةٌ وَفِعْلُ شَرْطٍ وَجَوابُ شَرْط. وَهَذِهِ الأَدَواتُ تَجْزِمُ الفِعْلَيْن. مِثال: إِنْ تَتَّقوا اللهَ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ فُرْقاناً.

dialogue.ar: إِن تَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّكُمْ فُرْقَانًا.
dialogue.tr: in tattaqū llāha yajʿal lakum furqānan
dialogue.en: If you fear Allah, He will make for you a criterion.
dialogue.ur: Agar tum Allah se daro to woh tumhare liye furqan banayega.

dialogue.ar: وَمَا تَفْعَلُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ يَعْلَمْهُ اللَّهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-mā tafʿalū min khayrin yaʿlamhu llāh
dialogue.en: Whatever good you do, Allah knows it.
dialogue.ur: Tum jo bhi neki karo Allah use jaanta hai.

dialogue.ar: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللهُ بِهِ خَيْراً يُفَقِّهْهُ في الدّينِ.
dialogue.tr: man yuridi llāhu bihi khayran yufaqqihhu fid-dīn
dialogue.en: Whomever Allah wants good for, He gives understanding of the religion.
dialogue.ur: Allah jis ke saath bhalai chahta hai use deen ki samajh deta hai.

dialogue.ar: مَتى تَدْرُسْ بِجِدٍّ تَنْجَحْ.
dialogue.tr: matā tadrus bijiddin tanjaḥ
dialogue.en: Whenever you study seriously, you succeed.
dialogue.ur: Jab bhi tum mehnat se parho ge kamyab ho jaoge.

dialogue.ar: أَيَّ دَرْسٍ تُراجِعْ تَفْهَمْهُ.
dialogue.tr: ayya darsin turājiʿ tafhamh
dialogue.en: Whichever lesson you review, you understand it.
dialogue.ur: Tum jo bhi sabaq dohrao ge use samajh jaoge.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَما تُعامِلِ النّاسَ يُعامِلوكَ.
dialogue.tr: kayfamā tuʿāmili n-nāsa yuʿāmilūk
dialogue.en: However you treat people, they treat you.
dialogue.ur: Tum logon se jaisa sulook karoge woh tum se waisa hi karenge.

dialogue.ar: حَيْثُما تَجْلِسْ أَجْلِسْ بِجانِبِكَ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaythumā tajlis ajlis bijānibik
dialogue.en: Wherever you sit, I will sit beside you.
dialogue.ur: Tum jahan bhi baitho ge main tumhare paas baithunga.

dialogue.ar: أَيْنَما تَكُنْ تَجِدْ أَصْدِقاءَ.
dialogue.tr: aynamā takun tajid aṣdiqāʾ
dialogue.en: Wherever you are, you find friends.
dialogue.ur: Tum jahan bhi ho dost paa loge.

q.en: Which is a jussive conditional tool?
q.ur: Inmein se shart ki jazim adaat kaun si hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ الكَلِماتِ الآتِيَةِ أَداةُ شَرْطٍ جازِمَة؟

q.en: What are the three parts of a conditional sentence?
q.ur: Shart ke jumle ke teen hisse kaun se hain?

q.en: What does «مَتى» mean in «مَتى تَدْرُسْ بِجِدٍّ تَنْجَحْ»?
q.ur: «مَتى تَدْرُسْ بِجِدٍّ تَنْجَحْ» mein «مَتى» ka kya matlab hai?
q.ar: ما مَعْنى «مَتى» في «مَتى تَدْرُسْ بِجِدٍّ تَنْجَحْ»؟

q.en: What do these tools do to the two verbs?
q.ur: Yeh adawat dono fi'l ko kya karti hain?

intro.en: Read three sentences about Muslim scholars, the scientific renaissance and Muslims who migrated, and mark each one true or false. The first two are about scholars and science in the past, and the third is about Muslims who moved to America and Europe.
intro.ur: Musalman ulama, ilmi nashat-e-saniya aur hijrat karne wale Musalmanon ke baare mein teen jumle parhein aur har ek ko sahi ya ghalat batayein. Pehle do jumle maazi ke ulama aur ilm ke baare mein hain, teesra America aur Europe jaane wale Musalmanon ke baare mein hai.
intro.ar: اقْرَأِ الجُمَلَ الثَّلاثَ عَنْ عُلَماءِ المُسْلِمينَ وَالنَّهْضَةِ العِلْمِيَّةِ وَالمُهاجِرين، وَحَدِّدِ الصَّحيحَةَ وَالخاطِئَة. الجُمْلَتانِ الأولَيانِ عَنِ العُلَماءِ وَالعِلْمِ قَديماً، وَالثّالِثَةُ عَنِ المُسْلِمينَ في أَمْريكا وَأُوروبّا.

dialogue.ar: شَجَّعَ الحُكّامُ العُلَماءَ وَأَنْفَقوا عَلى الجامِعاتِ، فَقامَتِ النَّهْضَةُ العِلْمِيَّةُ.
dialogue.tr: shajjaʿa l-ḥukkāmu l-ʿulamāʾa wa-ʾanfaqwā ʿalā l-jāmiʿāt fa-qāmati n-nahḍatu l-ʿilmiyya
dialogue.en: The rulers encouraged scholars and spent on universities, so the scientific renaissance arose.
dialogue.ur: Hukmaranon ne ulama ki hausla afzai ki aur jamiaat par kharch kiya, yun ilmi nashat-e-saniya qaim hui.

dialogue.ar: تَمَتَّعَ العُلَماءُ بِحُرِّيَّةِ البَحْثِ وَالتَّأْليفِ.
dialogue.tr: tamattaʿa l-ʿulamāʾu biḥurriyyati l-baḥthi wat-taʾlīf
dialogue.en: Scholars enjoyed freedom of research and writing.
dialogue.ur: Ulama ko tehqeeq aur tasneef ki azadi haasil thi.

dialogue.ar: هاجَرَ كَثيرٌ مِنَ المُسْلِمينَ إِلى أُوروبّا وَأَمْريكا.
dialogue.tr: hājara kathīrun mina l-muslimīna ilā ūrūbbā wa-ʾamrīkā
dialogue.en: Many Muslims migrated to Europe and America.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se Musalman Europe aur America hijrat kar gaye.

options_ar: تَرَكَ بَلَدَهُ وَانْتَقَلَ إِلى بَلَدٍ آخَر

intro.en: Practise speaking in pairs and in groups about emigration and about the good and bad sides of a Muslim's life in a non-Muslim country. Ask and answer the questions with a partner.
intro.ur: Do logon aur gurooh mein hijrat ke baare mein aur ghair-Muslim mulk mein Musalman ki zindagi ke achhe aur bure pehluon par baat karna mashq karein. Saathi ke saath sawal-jawab karein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الحَديثِ مَعَ زَميلٍ وَفي مَجْموعَةٍ عَنِ الهِجْرَةِ وَعَنْ مَحاسِنِ حَياةِ المُسْلِمِ وَمَساوِئِها في بَلَدٍ غَيْرِ مُسْلِم. اسْأَلْ وَأَجِبْ مَعَ زَميلِك.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَرْغَبُ في السَّفَرِ إِلى بَلَدٍ آخَرَ لِلدِّراسَةِ أَوِ العَمَلِ؟ لِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: hal targhabu fī s-safari ilā baladin ʾākhara lid-dirāsati awi l-ʿamal limādhā
dialogue.en: Would you like to travel to another country to study or work? Why?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap parhai ya kaam ke liye kisi aur mulk jana chahte hain? Kyun?

dialogue.ar: مَنْ مِنْ أَقارِبِكَ أَوْ زُمَلائِكَ يَعيشُ خارِجَ بَلَدِهِ؟ وَفي أَيِّ بَلَدٍ؟
dialogue.tr: man min aqāribika aw zumalāʾika yaʿīshu khārija baladih wa-fī ayyi balad
dialogue.en: Which of your relatives or colleagues lives outside his country? And in which country?
dialogue.ur: Aap ke rishtedaron ya saathiyon mein se kaun apne mulk se bahar rehta hai? Aur kis mulk mein?

dialogue.ar: ما المَحاسِنُ الَّتي يَراها المُهاجِرُ في حَياتِهِ الجَديدَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā l-maḥāsinu llatī yarāhā l-muhājiru fī ḥayātihi l-jadīda
dialogue.en: What good points does the emigrant see in his new life?
dialogue.ur: Muhajir apni nayi zindagi mein kaun si khoobiyan dekhta hai?

dialogue.ar: وَما المَساوِئُ الَّتي يَخْشاها عَلى أَبْنائِهِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa-mā l-masāwiʾu llatī yakhshāhā ʿalā abnāʾih
dialogue.en: And what bad points does he fear for his children?
dialogue.ur: Aur woh apni aulad ke liye kin buraiyon se darta hai?

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ يَحْفَظُ المُسْلِمُ دينَهُ وَلُغَتَهُ في بَلَدٍ جَديدٍ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa yaḥfaẓu l-muslimu dīnahu wa-lughatahu fī baladin jadīd
dialogue.en: How can a Muslim preserve his religion and language in a new country?
dialogue.ur: Ek Musalman naye mulk mein apna deen aur zubaan kaise mehfooz rakhe?

options_ar: عَمَلٌ يَقومُ بِهِ أَفْرادُ مَجْموعَةٍ مَعاً

title.ar: الإِمْلاءُ: الأَلِفُ اللَّيِّنَةُ في الأَسْماءِ الأَعْجَمِيَّةِ
title.en: Spelling: the soft alif in foreign names

intro.en: Rule: in foreign (non-Arabic) names, the soft alif at the end is written as ى (like موسى، عيسى، بخارى، كسرى، مَتّى، الموسيقى) or as ا (like آسيا، أوروبا، أمريكا، أبوجا). Learn the continents and countries too.
intro.ur: Qaida: ghair-Arabi naamon mein akhir ki alif-e-layyina kabhi ى se likhi jati hai (jaise موسى، عيسى، بخارى، كسرى، مَتّى، الموسيقى) aur kabhi ا se (jaise آسيا، أوروبا، أمريكا، أبوجا). براعظم aur mulkon ke naam bhi seekhein.
intro.ar: القاعِدَة: في الأَسْماءِ الأَعْجَمِيَّةِ (غَيْرِ العَرَبِيَّة) تُكْتَبُ الأَلِفُ اللَّيِّنَةُ في الآخِرِ ى (مِثْلَ موسى، عيسى، بخارى، كسرى، مَتّى، الموسيقى) أَوْ ا (مِثْلَ آسيا، أوروبا، أمريكا، أبوجا). وَتَعَلَّمْ أَسْماءَ القارّاتِ وَالبُلْدانِ أَيْضاً.

q.en: How is the final soft alif written in «موسى»?
q.ur: «موسى» mein akhir ki alif-e-layyina kaise likhi gayi?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تُكْتَبُ الأَلِفُ اللَّيِّنَةُ في آخِرِ «موسى»؟

q.en: How is the final soft alif written in «أمريكا»?
q.ur: «أمريكا» mein akhir ki alif-e-layyina kaise likhi gayi?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تُكْتَبُ الأَلِفُ اللَّيِّنَةُ في آخِرِ «أمريكا»؟

q.ur: Inmein se continent kaun sa hai?

q.en: Which word is written with ى?
q.ur: Inmein se kaun sa lafz ى se likha jata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ الكَلِماتِ الآتِيَةِ تُكْتَبُ بِـ ى؟

title.ar: قَواعِدُ اللُّغَةِ (ب): أَدَواتُ الشَّرْطِ غَيْرُ الجازِمَةِ

intro.en: Some conditional tools do not make the verbs jussive: لَوْ، لَوْلا، لَمّا، كُلَّما، إِذا. Example: لَوْ ذاكَرْتَ لَنَجَحْتَ – If you had studied, you would have succeeded. Note: لَوْ and لَوْلا usually put لـ on the result.
intro.ur: Kuch shart ki adawat fi'l ko majzoom nahi kartin: لَوْ، لَوْلا، لَمّا، كُلَّما، إِذا. Misal: لَوْ ذاكَرْتَ لَنَجَحْتَ – Agar tum parhte to kamyab hote. Dhyan dein: لَوْ aur لَوْلا ke jawab par aksar لـ aata hai.
intro.ar: بَعْضُ أَدَواتِ الشَّرْطِ لا تَجْزِمُ الفِعْلَيْن، وَهِيَ: لَوْ، لَوْلا، لَمّا، كُلَّما، إِذا. مِثال: لَوْ ذاكَرْتَ لَنَجَحْتَ. وَيَأْتي جَوابُ «لَوْ» وَ«لَوْلا» غالِباً مَقْرونَاً بِاللّام.

dialogue.ar: لَوْ ذاكَرْتَ لَنَجَحْتَ وَما نَدِمْتَ.
dialogue.tr: law dhākarta lanajaḥta wa-mā nadimt
dialogue.en: If you had studied, you would have succeeded and would not have regretted.
dialogue.ur: Agar tum parhte to kamyab hote aur pachhtate nahi.

dialogue.ar: لَوْلا الهِجْرَةُ لَكُنْتُ امْرَأً مِنَ الأَنْصارِ.
dialogue.tr: lawlā l-hijratu la-kuntu imraʾan mina l-anṣār
dialogue.en: Were it not for the Hijra, I would have been one of the Ansar.
dialogue.ur: Agar hijrat na hoti to main Ansar mein se ek hota.

dialogue.ar: كُلَّما اقْتَرَبَ الامْتِحانُ ابْتَعَدَ عَنّي النَّوْمُ.
dialogue.tr: kullamā qtaraba l-imtiḥānu btaʿada ʿannī n-nawm
dialogue.en: Whenever the exam drew near, sleep moved away from me.
dialogue.ur: Jab bhi imtihan qareeb aata, neend mujh se door ho jaati.

dialogue.ar: إِذا وُسِّدَ الأَمْرُ إِلى غَيْرِ أَهْلِهِ فَانْتَظِرِ السّاعَةَ.
dialogue.tr: idhā wussida l-amru ilā ghayri ahlihi fa-ntaẓiri s-sāʿa
dialogue.en: When a matter is given to someone unfit, wait for the Hour.
dialogue.ur: Jab koi kaam na-ahal ko saunp diya jaye to qayamat ka intezar karo.

vocab.en: if not for, were it not for

q.ur: Inmein se kaun si adaat jazim NAHI hai?

options: If not for / Agar na hota

q.en: What often comes at the start of the result after «لَوْ»?
q.ur: «لَوْ» ke baad jawab ke shuru mein aksar kya aata hai?
q.ar: ما الَّذي يَأْتي غالِباً في أَوَّلِ الجَوابِ بَعْدَ «لَوْ»؟
